titulo.pt: 19. Uma parede que quebra e uma bomba
titulo.en: 19. A wall that breaks and a bomb
titulo.es: 19. Una pared que se rompe y una bomba

resumo.pt: Aba Physics › Damage: Destruction com Generate Fragments e Explosive com Particle Explosion.
resumo.en: Physics tab › Damage: Destruction with Generate Fragments and Explosive with Particle Explosion.
resumo.es: Pestaña Physics › Damage: Destruction con Generate Fragments y Explosive con Particle Explosion.

abertura.pt: Vamos fazer o cubo quebrar em pedaços quando uma bomba cair nele.
abertura.en: Let's make the cube break into pieces when a bomb falls on it.
abertura.es: Vamos a hacer que el cubo se rompa en pedazos cuando una bomba caiga sobre él.

encerramento.pt: Pronto: a bomba explode ao bater e a parede vira pedaços.
encerramento.en: Done: the bomb explodes on impact and the wall turns into pieces.
encerramento.es: Listo: la bomba explota al chocar y la pared se vuelve pedazos.

texto.pt: Na 3D View, clique no cubo: ele será a parede.
texto.en: In the 3D View, click the cube: it will be the wall.
texto.es: En la 3D View, haz clic en el cubo: será la pared.

checagem.expr: C.active_object is not None and C.active_object.select and C.active_object.type == 'MESH'

texto.pt: No Properties, abra a aba Physics e, no topo dela, clique em Damage.
texto.en: In Properties, open the Physics tab and, at its top, click Damage.
texto.es: En Properties, abre la pestaña Physics y, arriba, haz clic en Damage.

checagem.expr: any(a.spaces.active.context == 'PHYSICS' for a in C.screen.areas if a.type == 'PROPERTIES') and C.window_manager.ae_physics_panel_category == 'DAMAGE'

texto.pt: Abra o painel Destruction, clique em Generate Fragments... e depois em OK.
texto.en: Open the Destruction panel, click Generate Fragments... and then OK.
texto.es: Abre el panel Destruction, haz clic en Generate Fragments... y luego en OK.

checagem.expr: C.active_object is not None and C.active_object.type == 'MESH' and C.active_object.game.use_destruction and C.active_object.game.destruction.fragments is not None

dica.pt: O painel começa fechado: clique no nome Destruction para abrir. Os pedaços vão para a camada 20, escondidos.
dica.en: The panel starts closed: click the name Destruction to open it. The pieces go to layer 20, hidden.
dica.es: El panel empieza cerrado: haz clic en el nombre Destruction para abrirlo. Los pedazos van a la capa 20, ocultos.

texto.pt: Faça a bomba: Add › Mesh › UV Sphere. Depois G, Z, 5, Enter: ela fica em cima do cubo.
texto.en: Make the bomb: Add › Mesh › UV Sphere. Then G, Z, 5, Enter: it sits above the cube.
texto.es: Haz la bomba: Add › Mesh › UV Sphere. Después G, Z, 5, Enter: queda encima del cubo.

checagem.expr: C.active_object is not None and C.active_object.type == 'MESH' and C.active_object.location.z > 3 and not C.active_object.game.use_destruction

texto.pt: No topo da aba Physics, clique em Physics e troque Physics Type para Rigid Body: a bomba vai cair.
texto.en: At the top of the Physics tab, click Physics and change Physics Type to Rigid Body: the bomb will fall.
texto.es: Arriba en la pestaña Physics, haz clic en Physics y cambia Physics Type a Rigid Body: la bomba caerá.

checagem.expr: C.active_object is not None and C.active_object.type == 'MESH' and C.active_object.location.z > 3 and C.active_object.game.physics_type in {'RIGID_BODY', 'DYNAMIC'}

texto.pt: Clique em Damage de novo, abra o painel Explosive e marque Enabled.
texto.en: Click Damage again, open the Explosive panel and check Enabled.
texto.es: Haz clic en Damage otra vez, abre el panel Explosive y marca Enabled.

checagem.expr: C.active_object is not None and C.active_object.type == 'MESH' and C.active_object.location.z > 3 and C.active_object.game.use_explosive

dica.pt: Explode on Impact já vem ligado: a bomba explode quando bate em algo.
dica.en: Explode on Impact is already on: the bomb explodes when it hits something.
dica.es: Explode on Impact ya viene activado: la bomba explota cuando choca con algo.

texto.pt: No mesmo painel, marque Particle Explosion: fogo, fumaça e faíscas.
texto.en: In the same panel, check Particle Explosion: fire, smoke and sparks.
texto.es: En el mismo panel, marca Particle Explosion: fuego, humo y chispas.

checagem.expr: C.active_object is not None and C.active_object.type == 'MESH' and C.active_object.game.use_explosive and C.active_object.game.explosive.use_particle_explosion

texto.pt: Aperte P: a bomba cai, explode e a parede quebra. Esc sai. Depois, clique em Next.
texto.en: Press P: the bomb falls, explodes and the wall breaks. Esc quits. Then click Next.
texto.es: Presiona P: la bomba cae, explota y la pared se rompe. Esc sale. Después, haz clic en Next.

dica.pt: Se a parede não quebrar, baixe Break Impulse no painel Destruction do cubo.
dica.en: If the wall does not break, lower Break Impulse in the cube's Destruction panel.
dica.es: Si la pared no se rompe, baja Break Impulse en el panel Destruction del cubo.
